name: Chameleon

unlock.how: play a game of bashou spot

tips: `bashou spot` : an IPv6, a hash, base64? Say what it is, fast. 25 seconds, go!
A JWT always starts with eyJ: it's base64 for {"
Groups of 8-4-4-4-12 hex digits, and the third starts with 4? A UUID, version 4.
Basic auth is only base64: anyone can read the password back. Never send it without HTTPS.
personal: My eyes move one by one. Yours can learn to spot a hash in a log at a glance.
A mistake in `bashou spot` puts the string back in the bag. You'll see it again, and know it.
Fast tongue, sharp eyes. Every hunter in my family has one or the other.
